summary: UndirectedAdaptor concatenated incoming and outgoing edges without reversing incoming edge references, preventing algorithms that follow edge targets from traversing against the underlying directed orientation. The fix reverses incoming references and updates the associated iterator and reference types consistently. The regression test added by the fix searches backward along a directed chain using A*: the parent implementation should return None and panic at path.unwrap(). The proposed reversal restores the exact parent implementation while preserving all fixed-revision tests. No tests were run.
